tests.test: RP-04 Join over the wire: closed, open, leave

asserts.check: debug mode (admin override) off: wards treat us like a normal player: do=hook, name=lock.debugMode, args={on=false}, expect=false, label=debug mode (admin override) off: wards treat us like a normal player
Bob is connected like a second client: peerConnected: do=check, peer=Bob, label=Bob is connected like a second client
Join is closed: the request does nothing: do=hook, name=lock.isGuest, args={target=chest, who=Bob}, expect=false, label=Join is closed: the request does nothing
Alice opens Join: do=hook, name=lock.openJoin, args={target=chest, on=true}, expect=true, label=Alice opens Join
Join is open: Bob is on the list: do=hook, name=lock.isGuest, args={target=chest, who=Bob}, expect=true, label=Join is open: Bob is on the list
Bob is listed: do=hook, name=lock.guests, args={target=chest}, contains=Bob, label=Bob is listed
Bob leaves again: do=hook, name=lock.isGuest, args={target=chest, who=Bob}, expect=false, label=Bob leaves again
noErrors: source=LockSmith
asserts.detail: no errors since the test started
